name: Dicyclomine Hydrochloride

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Cardiovascular conditions : worsening of conditions (5.2) Peripheral and central nervous system : heat prostration can occur with drug use (fever and heat stroke due to decreased sweating); drug should be discontinued and supportive measures instituted (5.3) Psychosis and delirium have been…

summary: Warnings for dicyclomine hydrochloride include the worsening of heart conditions. [3] The medicine can also cause heat stroke and fever due to decreased sweating, as well as mental changes such as confusion and losing touch with reality. [3] A small computer model, rather than tests on people, found low risk scores of 18 for the liver and 30 for the heart. [M]
